what: SESSION_ID-empty path has no proposed admission block state
scenario_or_breakage: The plan keeps rename gated on non-empty SESSION_ID and lists SESSION_ID empty as a skipped rename/publish edge case, but it never assigns ADMISSION_READY=false plus a block reason for that path. If the current generic empty-SESSION footer survives, operators may be told to continue even though the issue was never renamed to [DESIGNED] and /implement will fail admission.
suggested_fix: Initialize admission as blocked, e.g. ADMISSION_READY=false and ADMISSION_BLOCK_REASON=session-id-missing, persist/export it, and update Step 5d/render guidance to use the blocked footer for this path.

what: scrub-only failures before the scrub gate can omit SCRUB_OK
scenario_or_breakage: The plan only requires SCRUB_OK=false for fail-closed scrub results, while existing pre-scrub validation/staging failures often exit 0 with PUBLISH_OK=false. If scrub-only returns without SCRUB_OK and design-publish only checks explicit false/nonzero, the full flush can still run after a failed preflight.
suggested_fix: In --scrub-only mode, make every expected failure path before or during staging/scrub emit SCRUB_OK=false, make design-publish require SCRUB_OK=true exactly before full flush, and add a missing-SCRUB_OK scrub-only test.
